fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects RunDLL32.exe spawning explorer.exe as child, which is very uncommon, often observes Gamarue spawning the explorer.exe process in an unusual way
fields.name: RunDLL32 Spawning Explorer
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((src.process.image.path contains "\\rundll32.exe" and tgt.process.image.path contains "\\explorer.exe") and (not src.process.cmdline contains "\\shell32.dll,Control_RunDLL")))
